note: Retired Compiler Revision and Executor identities (pre-ADR-0065 forms). Each entry names the commit on main that first added the document and the path at which `git show history:<path>` resolves it byte-identically. Identities are reserved and never reused (ADR 0049, 0050); this table is how findings/ and retained Evidence that cite them stay resolvable after the documents left the working tree.
